articleTitle: Investigation of the Effect of Al2O3 - TiO2 Nano Particles on Engine Noise Using Machine Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: In this study, the effects of different ratios of Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nano particles on exhaust noise were analyzed using statistical and machine learning methods, employing a 1.2 TSI engine. Response surface methodology was used for the experimental design, where Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> ratios, as well as engine speed input parameters, were determined as the factors, and noise values were selected as the output parameters.

articleTitle: Research and application of Faster RCNN-based video action detection model
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: This paper illustrates the research process of a Faster RCNN-based video action detection model and its application to assist safety production in the power industry. The model combines the Faster R-CNN method and the dual channel theory to achieve all the use of deep learning techniques in obtaining the area of interest and extracting video characteristics. Using the dual-channel network model extraction feature, two different Faster R-CNN networks are used to extract apparent features and action features from the video, and then the two types of features fused to form a time-space domain feature, used to represent the original features of the video. Finally, when the extracted feature is classified, the frame and the timing level are considered, and the action pipeline model is constructed when the video recognition task is studied. The model can sequentially connect the interest area on the frame and form a campaign in accordance with the frame order and selecting the optimal campaign pipe as a video final action judgment result. The category of the optimal campaign pipe is marked as a classification of the entire video operation, which constitutes an interested region set of the optimal campaign pipe as a position of the entire video operation. The algorithm model trained with this model performs well in practical power industry application scenarios, assisting supervisors in timely detection of potential hazardous situations in the form of irregularities in personnel operations, equipment and environmental abnormalities, and assisting in improving the operational efficiency and safety management level of power enterprises.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation on Partition Configuration of Micro PMU in Multi-branch Distribution Network Based on Traveling Wave Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: In order to ensure the stability and accuracy of fault ranging in distribution network and take into account economy, this paper proposes a principle of multi-division dominant power grid characteristic network division in view of the problems faced by fault ranging in distribution network, which divides the large-scale distribution network into regional characteristic networks, so as to reduce the difficulty of fault distance measurement in distribution network. At the same time, based on the feature network, a new micro-PMU (Phasor Measurement Units) configuration scheme is proposed, which provides a reliable data basis for the fault ranging algorithm of distribution network. Finally, the simulation model of IEEE14-node topology standard distribution network is constructed by using MATLAB simulation software, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed characteristic network division and micro-PMU configuration theory.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization of steam and water flow parameters in loose and condition processes
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: Loosening and conditioning is one of the important processes in cigarette production, which converts tobacco chunks into tobacco leaves through the action of steam and water. Steam and water are the main energy consumption in this process. To achieve energy conservation and consumption reduction in the production process, while ensuring that process indicators such as tobacco moisture and temperature remain unchanged, the flow of steam and water during the production process should be minimized as much as possible. Based on actual working conditions, a combination of Seagull algorithm optimized backpropagation neural network modeling and multi-objective Golden Eagle optimization algorithm was proposed to solve the minimum flow parameters of steam and water. Through experimental comparison and analysis, Seagull algorithm optimized backpropagation neural network compared with genetic algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm has good accuracy in establishing such engineering problem models; Compared with the traditional multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm and the non dominated sorting genetic algorithm II, the multi-objective Golden Eagle optimization algorithm has more uniform Pareto solution distribution and stronger optimization ability through Hypervolume verification. As the set parameter of steam and water flow, its solution can effectively achieve energy saving and consumption reduction in the actual production process.

articleTitle: Effects of Ammonia on the Flame Characteristics of Liquefied Petroleum Gas External Premixed Combustion
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: Liquefied petroleum gas or better known as LPG is a fuel and flammable gas commonly used by Indonesians for household consumption such as cooking. The combustion process of LPG has negative effects on ecological life if accumulated for a long period of time as it contributes to CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> accumulation and climate change. Ammonia can be used in the substitution of fuels such as LPG and as an alternative energy source for the future because of carbon-free fuel and environmentally friendly combustion. The current study investigates the effects of ammonia as the carbon-free fuel in the LPG using an external premixed combustor under stoichiometric fuel mixtures. Volumetric ratios of 0%–50% between LPG and NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> were investigated to understand the effect of replacing LPG with NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> on flame characteristics. Oxygen was used as the oxidizer to exclude nitrogen, which is an inhibitor of flame reactivity. A high-speed camera was employed to capture the flame propagation, and the recording was processed to determine the flame characteristics of the mixtures. The experimental results show that ammonia influence on the flame height, flame angle, and dimensionless flame height normalized by the nozzle diameter. A larger replacement of ammonia resulted in a shorter flame height and larger flame angle.

articleTitle: An Overview of Comparators in A/D Data Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: In order to determine the digital representation of an analog input signal, the comparator stage compares the input analog signal with reference voltages. Over the years, several static and dynamic comparator structures have been designed and implemented to minimize power consumption, delay, and area occupation in analog-to-digital converters. Researchers have examined the power consumption, speed, kickback noise, and manufacturing technology of transistors used in comparators. Recent studies have demonstrated that leveraging advanced technologies, such as carbon nanotube transistors, enables the realization of fully differential, low-power, noise-insensitive dynamic structures. These structures exhibit a relative improvement in all general parameters and offer a suitable figure of merit.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Metal Oxide Surge Arresters Models by using ATPDraw Software
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: Lightning is a natural phenomenon that occurs quite often, especially in Malaysia. Lightning is very dangerous as the voltage of the lightning is very high which can affect human daily living by damaging the electrical and electronic components. Thus, the study of lightning surges is essential in order to coordinate insulation to the electric power system. The function of the surge protection device (SPD) is to divert the surge current from the distribution line. This paper performed a comparison performance of simplified modeling of metal oxide surge arrester (MOSA). The typical models of the surge protection devices (SPDs) such as the IEEE and Pinceti model were modeled and simulated using the ATPDraw software and the performance of those model were studied with several manufacturer surge arresters. The MATLAB software was used to obtain the results on the impulse voltage signal of the SPDs. Both models’ performances are being investigated, and MATLAB has been used to examine the voltage data. According to the findings, the IEEE model is more effective for usage as a lightning arrester in MV networks.

articleTitle: Comparison of LC Passive Low-pass Filters Performance on Electric Springs
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: Electric Springs can effectively alleviate the problems caused by voltage instability on the network side, but the input of its different parameter filters will inevitably affect the power quality on the load side. To study this problem, this paper takes the second generation Electric Springs as the research object, analyzes the transfer function of LC filters around the three basic forms of LC passive low-pass filters, and derives the cutoff frequency from attenuation characteristics graph of the second-order oscillation link to derive the basis for the selection of cutoff frequency, establish the normalized LC low-pass filter design data, and use it as a benchmark filter to derive the filter inductance and capacitance values in practice. The voltage stabilizing effect of each of the three filters is derived while comparing the three forms of LC low-pass filters and deriving the advantages and disadvantages of each of the three filters in electric springs with the help of MATLAB/Simulink software.

articleTitle: Research on the new trend and improvement path of the life cycle construction cost management of distribution network
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: At present, the profit space of the power grid enterprise is further compressed and the investment supervision is further strengthened, therefore the efficiency and benefit of investment in the power grid enterprise gradually become the focus of attention. Power grid project construction is a key investment project because of the huge amount of investment. Scientific management of construction funds and optimization of the life cycle cost management for power grid projects have become the important issues in urgent need to overcome, so as to achieve the optimal economic and social benefits of the construction project. Traditional methods only achieve local optimization of cost management, rather than global optimization. This paper explores the new trend of power grid construction cost management, and then studies the multi-stage equipment assets optimization method of the whole life cycle of distribution network, also establishes the relevant model and puts forward the solution method. This paper will provide an improvement path for the whole life cycle construction cost management of distribution network.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Power System Load Flow Analysis in New Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: This paper proposes a new power grid load flow calculation method, which improves the traditional forward-backward sweep algorithm. It simplifies the establishment of the network mathematical model using the network matrices. It employs an adaptive threshold filtering method to process real-time acquired power grid data, overcoming the issues of disturbances in the new power system. The paper first introduces the process of establishing the power system mathematical model based on the network matrices, then explains the principles of the adaptive threshold filtering method, and subsequently provides a detailed description of the proposed method. Finally, a section of a 10kV distribution line in a city in China is selected as a case study to verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Smart Contract-based Security Auditing for Web Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: The increasing reliance on web applications has led to a growing concern for their security vulnerabilities. Traditional security auditing processes often suffer from limitations such as manual intervention, lack of transparency, and centralized control. To address these challenges, we propose a novel approach utilizing blockchain technology and smart contracts to perform security auditing for web applications in a decentralized and transparent manner. The smart contract, named “WebAppSecurityAudit,” facilitates the auditing process by allowing users to conduct security audits on web applications. The contract leverages the Ethereum blockchain and employs the Solidity programming language. The contract’s core functionality includes creating and retrieving audits, storing audit details on the blockchain, and emitting events for audit notifications. The novelty of the proposed approach lies in several aspects. Firstly, by utilizing smart contracts, the proposed model eliminate the need for intermediaries or centralized authorities, ensuring a trustless and transparent auditing process. Auditors can directly interact with the contract, creating audits and storing the results on the blockchain. Web application owners can verify the audit details independently, increasing trust and accountability. Secondly, the proposed approach enables a decentralized audit record system. The use of blockchain technology ensures immutability and tamper-proof storage of audit information. This feature enhances the integrity of audit records, making them resistant to manipulation or unauthorized modifications. Thirdly, the contract introduces the concept of auditors’ addresses and web application addresses, associating audits with specific entities. This association allows for efficient retrieval of audit details and enables traceability in case of disputes or inquiries. In conclusion, the proposed smart contract-based security auditing approach offers a decentralized, transparent, and tamper-proof solution for assessing the security of web applications.

articleTitle: Optimization of Stability Control Strategy for Pakistan's AC-DC Hybrid Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: AC/DC hybrid power grids have the inherent characteristics of vulnerability, controllability, cascading failures and so on. Stability control technology has been proved to be a key measure to guarantee security and reliable operation of AC/DC hybrid power grids in engineering practice. This paper focuses on the security and stability problems faced by Pakistan power grid, whose first HVDC transmission project put into commercial operation in 2021, as well as current countermeasures. A technical scheme is proposed to optimize the current stability control strategy taking advantage of the fast and controllable characteristics of the DC system, which has been verified to be effective through simulation cases.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Task Scheduling in Cloud Data Center using Cat Swarm Optimization Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: Cloud computing is a burgeoning computing paradigm that offers reusability and cost-effectiveness, including a diverse array of autonomous systems. The business offers consumers customizable and expandable services on a pay-per-use basis, according to their needs and preferences. The efficacy of cloud infrastructure is contingent upon the allocation and arrangement of tasks. Efficient task scheduling plays a crucial role in minimizing power consumption within cloud infrastructures, while simultaneously maximizing the profitability of service providers through the reduction of user job processing time. The primary purpose of this study is to investigate the effectiveness of the multi-objective Cat Swarm Optimization (TA-CSO) in optimizing job scheduling for improved efficiency. The algorithm presented in this study aims to enhance the efficiency of the cloud environment by optimizing many factors such as energy consumption, cost, resource utilization, and processing time. The outcome achieved through the utilization of TA-CSO is likewise replicated by the implementation of an open-source cloud platform known as CloudSim. The findings derived from this study are contrasted with the current leading scheduling algorithms, revealing that the suggested algorithm (TA-CSO) yields an optimal equilibrium of outcomes for various objectives.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Module Health Assessment Based on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Infrared Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) power generation systems are a new type of power generation system which directly converts solar radiation into electrical energy using the photovoltaic effect of semiconductor materials. However, various problems inevitably occur in the operation of PV systems due to the aging of solar cells and environmental conditions. The hot spot effect is one of the most common faults in PV modules, which not only causes abnormal temperature on the surface of the module but also damages the photovoltaic panel, affecting the overall power generation efficiency. In this paper, based on the multiscale data features of images in PV module defect diagnosis, the data correlations in different scenarios are explored to investigate the impact mechanism of several hot spot features (position, area, brightness difference) on the health condition of PV modules directly from the perspective of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) infrared images. By incorporating a multiscale data fusion algorithm, we established a comprehensive health assessment system for PV modules. Experimental analysis demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Capacity Optimization Configuration of Energy Storage System in Wind Farm Based on Sand Cat Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: Energy storage systems are capable of addressing the concerns of safety and stability in wind power integration. For the purpose of maximizing the benefits of energy storage systems for wind farms, an optimal configuration model of energy storage capacity for wind farms based on the sand cat swarm algorithm is proposed in this paper. First, according to the historical generation data of wind farms, the typical wind power days are screened out by the k-means clustering algorithm. Then, considering the constraints of energy storage power and capacity, the optimal configuration model of energy storage capacity is established with the goal of maximizing the net income of the wind-storage joint system. Finally, the sand cat swarm algorithm is used to find the optimal solution in each typical scenario, and a reasonable energy storage configuration scheme for wind farms is obtained.

articleTitle: Improving Buildings’ Metabolism by Rooftop Greenhouses
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: The paper focuses on the rooftop greenhouses’ capability to improve buildings’ metabolism and to provide carbon offset, due to the photosynthesis produced by the plants. The integration of the greenhouse with the building is achieved by controlled bidirectional air flows. A structural Simulink model of this system supports significant simulations.

articleTitle: Single-phase high-resistance ground fault identification method for distribution network based on improved whale algorithm and optimized support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: The characteristic signal of single-phase high resistance grounding fault in the distribution network is weak, and it is difficult to extract this signal. This paper proposes a single-phase high resistance grounding fault identification method for distribution networks based on improved whale algorithm optimized support vector machine. Firstly, the wavelet transform principle is used to transform the zero sequence current of the fault, and the transformed wavelet basis function decomposition graph is used to extract two feature indicators: wavelet coefficient energy ratio and wavelet entropy weight. Whale algorithm is introduced to optimize the recognition model of the support vector machine, and its constant inertia weight is adjusted to nonlinear exponential decay to improve the generalization ability of the algorithm. The simulation results show that the extracted features and recognition model can accurately identify the type of single-phase high resistance grounding fault.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional wind power prediction based on time-series characterization analysis and VMD-EMD quadratic decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: Wind power data receive wind volatility and have strong non-smoothness, making it difficult to achieve high accuracy in wind power prediction. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a wind power multi-step prediction model combining VMD (Variational Modal Decomposition), EMD (Empirical Modal Modal Decomposition), Hurst analysis and temporal entropy values. Firstly, the first decomposition of the historical wind power data is carried out by VMD decomposition ; then Hurst analysis is performed on the components of the first decomposition, and the components with low regularity are decomposed twice using EMD decomposition; then the components of the second decomposition are further filtered using permutation entropy, and the components with high entropy values are compared with the high The components with high entropy, high Hurst and low entropy of the secondary decomposition are formed into high randomness irregular component, regular component and low randomness low regularity component; for the three types of components, BP neural network is used to predict them respectively, and they are reorganized into wind power prediction values. The experiments prove that the model proposed in this paper has higher prediction accuracy and faster running time than the current mainstream models, and can achieve more efficient wind power prediction.

articleTitle: Research on the Speed Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Variable Bandwidth Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: To solve the problem that the fixed bandwidth linear active disturbance rejection controller (LADRC) cannot simultaneously meet the dynamic performance and noise suppression capability of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) speed loop, this article investigates the variable bandwidth linear active disturbance rejection controller (VB-LADRC) based on analyzing the influence of bandwidth of LADRC on the performance of system. A simple nonlinear function is used to realize the adaptive adjustment of the controller bandwidth under different operating conditions to coordinate the system immunity and noise immunity. A dual closed-loop vector control simulation model is established by MATLAB/Simulink for validation. The results show that compared with the traditional LADRC speed loop controller, the VB-LADRC speed loop controller can effectively adjust the size of LADRC bandwidth according to the changes in the motor operating conditions, which strengthens the immunity to disturbance and noise of LADRC speed controller, and thus reduces the fluctuation of PMSM speed and improves the dynamic performance of speed loop.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Travel Intention of Urban Residents Considering the Influence of Travel Time Perception
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: To explore the influencing factors of urban residents’ low-carbon travel intention and their interaction mechanism, the theoretical framework is improved by introducing the factors of low-carbon awareness, travel time perception, and policy factor based on the theory of planned behavior. Then the relationship between latent variables is revealed by focusing on residents’ attitude. By establishing a structural equation model and using Amos 26.0 to analyze the data of 279 questionnaires from Qing Dao. The results show subjective norm, policy factor, and attitude have a direct and significant impact on residents’ low-carbon travel intention. Attitude is mediating variable; travel time perception and low-carbon awareness could indirectly affect travel intention through attitude. The total effect value of latent variables on urban residents’ low-carbon travel intention rank from large to small as policy factor, subjective norm, attitude, low carbon awareness, and travel time perception. perceived behavior control affects residents’ low carbon travel intention insignificantly.

articleTitle: Smart Contract-based Authorization and Authentication in Cyber security
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Power, Energy Engineering and Computer Technology (PEECT)
abstract: Blockchain technology has gained significant attention due to its decentralized and transparent nature. However, ensuring secure user authentication and authorization in blockchain-based systems remains a critical challenge. This research paper presents an innovative authentication and authorization framework implemented as the “AuthContract” smart contract. The framework leverages the Solidity programming language and Ethereum blockchain platform to provide a robust solution for managing user access and privileges. The Auth- Contract enables the addition of new users by administrators, user authentication based on password hashing, and role-based authorization for accessing system resources. The contract’s functionalities are carefully designed to ensure security and prevent unauthorized access. Through an evaluation of the contract’s features and an analysis of potential vulnerabilities, this research paper demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed framework in achieving secure authentication and authorization in blockchain-based systems. The findings contribute to the advancement of secure user management practices and pave the way for enhanced security in decentralized applications and blockchain ecosystems.
